entities.name: Owain Goch ap Gruffydd
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Owain Goch ap Gruffudd was brother to Llywelyn ap Gruffudd and Dafydd ap Gruffudd and, for a brief period in the late 1240s and early 1250s, ruler of part of the Kingdom of Gwynedd.
